mechanism: Carisoprodol's CNS depressant effects and anticholinergic properties may potentiate bisacodyl's laxative action and increase risk of constipation or diarrhea, while bisacodyl may delay gastric emptying affecting carisoprodol absorption.
action: Monitor bowel function closely; carisoprodol may cause constipation which could be masked or worsened by bisacodyl use; consider alternative laxatives if constipation develops.
